CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ma AS
SELECT * FROM '/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/metric_app.parquet'
WHERE ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2021-03-05 22:30:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 03:00:00'
  AND day IN (DATE '2021-03-05', DATE '2021-03-06');
SELECT cmdb_id, count_star() AS n, count(DISTINCT kpi_name) AS kpis, min(ts) AS t0, max(ts) AS t1 FROM mc GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH tagged AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, ts, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM mc), base AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") AS b_sd, max("value") AS b_max, count_star() AS b_n FROM tagged WHERE (NOT in_win) GROUP BY 1, 2), win AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS w_avg, max("value") AS w_max, min("value") AS w_min, count_star() AS w_n FROM tagged WHERE in_win GROUP BY 1, 2)SELECT w.cmdb_id, w.kpi_name, round(b.b_avg, 4) AS b_avg, round(b.b_max, 4) AS b_max, round(w.w_avg, 4) AS w_avg, round(w.w_max, 4) AS w_max, round(((w.w_max - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z_max, round(((w.w_avg - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z_avg FROM win AS w INNER JOIN base AS b USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name) WHERE ((b.b_n >= 20) AND (w.w_n >= 3) AND (abs(((w.w_max - b.b_avg) / "nullif"(b.b_sd, 0))) > 4)) ORDER BY abs(z_max) DESC LIMIT 40 LIMIT 10000

WITH tagged AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM mc), base AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, avg("value") AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") AS b_sd, count_star() AS b_n FROM tagged WHERE (NOT in_win) GROUP BY 1, 2), win AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, max("value") AS w_max, count_star() AS w_n FROM tagged WHERE in_win GROUP BY 1, 2)SELECT cmdb_id, count_star() AS n_anom FROM win INNER JOIN base USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name) WHERE ((b_n >= 20) AND (w_n >= 3) AND (abs(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0))) > 4)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, tc, round(avg(rr), 3) AS rr, round(avg(sr), 3) AS sr, round(avg(cnt), 1) AS cnt, round(avg(mrt), 1) AS mrt FROM ma GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKRead')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS sdb_read, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKRTps')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS sdb_rtps, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKWrite')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS sdb_write, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKReadWrite')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS sdb_rw, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKTps')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS sdb_tps, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKPercentBusy')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS sdb_busy FROM mc WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') GROUP BY 1 HAVING (max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKRead')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END) > 0.5) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUCpuUtil')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS cpu, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUWio')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 3) AS wio, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUUserTime')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS usr, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((kpi_name = 'OSLinux-CPU_CPU_CPUSystemTime')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 2) AS sys FROM mc WHERE ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:15:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:15:00' AS TIMESTAMP))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH t AS (SELECT kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM mc WHERE ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01') AND ((kpi_name ~~* '%MEM%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Percent%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Space%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Used%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Swap%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%JVM%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Heap%'))))SELECT kpi_name, round(avg("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 3) AS b_avg, round(max("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 3) AS b_max, round(avg("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win), 3) AS w_avg, round(max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win), 3) AS w_max FROM t GROUP BY 1 HAVING (max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win) IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'MG01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS MG01, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'MG02')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS MG02, round(max(CASE  WHEN ((cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01')) THEN ("value") ELSE NULL END), 1) AS Tomcat01_sda FROM mc WHERE (kpi_name = 'OSLinux-OSLinux_LOCALDISK_LOCALDISK-sda_DSKRead') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000
SELECT cmdb_id, round(max("value"), 1) AS mx, arg_max(ts, "value") AS at_ts FROM mc WHERE (kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKRead') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, cmdb_id, round("value", 1) AS v FROM mc_day WHERE ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKRead') AND ("value" > 100)) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 10000
SELECT ts, cmdb_id, round("value", 1) AS v FROM mc_day WHERE ((kpi_name ~~ '%sda_DSKRead') AND ("value" > 100)) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, cmdb_id, log_name, substr("value", 1, 140) AS v FROM ls WHERE (log_name IN ('error', 'catalina', 'slow', 'localhost')) ORDER BY ts LIMIT 10000

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ts_win AS
SELECT cmdb_id, parent_id, span_id, trace_id, duration, ts
FROM '/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/trace_span.parquet'
WHERE ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 01:30:00'
  AND day = DATE '2021-03-06';

WITH child_sum AS (SELECT parent_id, sum(duration) AS kids FROM ts_win WHERE ((parent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id != '')) GROUP BY 1), self AS (SELECT s.cmdb_id, s.ts, (s.duration - COALESCE(c.kids, 0)) AS self_dur FROM ts_win AS s LEFT JOIN child_sum AS c ON ((c.parent_id = s.span_id)))SELECT cmdb_id, round(avg(self_dur) FILTER (WHERE (ts < CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS pre_avg, round(avg(self_dur) FILTER (WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS win_avg, round(avg(self_dur) FILTER (WHERE (ts > CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS post_avg, round(quantile_cont(self_dur, 0.99) FILTER (WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS win_p99, round(quantile_cont(self_dur, 0.99) FILTER (WHERE (ts < CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS pre_p99, count_star() AS n FROM self GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH child_sum AS (SELECT parent_id, sum(duration) AS kids FROM ts_win WHERE ((parent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id != '')) GROUP BY 1), self AS (SELECT s.cmdb_id, s.ts, (s.duration - COALESCE(c.kids, 0)) AS self_dur FROM ts_win AS s LEFT JOIN child_sum AS c ON ((c.parent_id = s.span_id)))SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, cmdb_id, round(avg(self_dur), 1) AS avg_self, round(quantile_cont(self_dur, 0.99), 1) AS p99_self, count_star() AS n FROM self GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING (count_star() > 50) ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

WITH t AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM mc WHERE ((kpi_name ~~* '%NETWORK%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%TCP%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Retrans%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Drop%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Err%')))SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, round(avg("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 3) AS b_avg, round(max("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 3) AS b_max, round(avg("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win), 3) AS w_avg, round(max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win), 3) AS w_max FROM t GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING (max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win) > (1.5 * "nullif"(max("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 0))) ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ts_win AS
SELECT cmdb_id, parent_id, span_id, trace_id, duration, ts
FROM '/Users/paul/workspace/onpair_like/datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/trace_span.parquet'
WHERE ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 00:00:00' AND TIMESTAMP '2021-03-06 01:30:00'
  AND day = DATE '2021-03-06';

WITH child_sum AS (SELECT parent_id, sum(duration) AS kids FROM ts_win WHERE ((parent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id != '')) GROUP BY 1), self AS (SELECT s.cmdb_id, s.ts, (s.duration - COALESCE(c.kids, 0)) AS self_dur FROM ts_win AS s LEFT JOIN child_sum AS c ON ((c.parent_id = s.span_id)))SELECT cmdb_id, round(avg(self_dur) FILTER (WHERE (ts < CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS pre_avg, round(avg(self_dur) FILTER (WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS win_avg, round(avg(self_dur) FILTER (WHERE (ts > CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS post_avg, round(quantile_cont(self_dur, 0.99) FILTER (WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS win_p99, round(quantile_cont(self_dur, 0.99) FILTER (WHERE (ts < CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP))), 1) AS pre_p99, count_star() AS n FROM self GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH child_sum AS (SELECT parent_id, sum(duration) AS kids FROM ts_win WHERE ((parent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id != '')) GROUP BY 1), self AS (SELECT s.cmdb_id, s.ts, (s.duration - COALESCE(c.kids, 0)) AS self_dur FROM ts_win AS s LEFT JOIN child_sum AS c ON ((c.parent_id = s.span_id)))SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, cmdb_id, round(avg(self_dur), 1) AS avg_self, round(quantile_cont(self_dur, 0.99), 1) AS p99_self, count_star() AS n FROM self GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING (count_star() > 50) ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

WITH t AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM mc WHERE ((kpi_name ~~* '%NETWORK%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%TCP%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Retrans%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Drop%') OR (kpi_name ~~* '%Err%')))SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, round(avg("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 3) AS b_avg, round(max("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 3) AS b_max, round(avg("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win), 3) AS w_avg, round(max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win), 3) AS w_max FROM t GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING (max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win) > (1.5 * "nullif"(max("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)), 0))) ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, round(min(rr), 2) AS rr_min, round(min(sr), 2) AS sr_min, round(max(mrt), 1) AS mrt_max, arg_max(tc, mrt) AS worst_tc FROM ma WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:20:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:10:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, cmdb_id, count_star() AS n_slow, round(max(duration), 0) AS max_dur FROM ts_win WHERE (duration > 5000) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

WITH slow_traces AS (SELECT DISTINCT trace_id FROM ts_win WHERE ((duration > 5000) AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:50:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))))SELECT s.trace_id, s.ts, s.cmdb_id, s.span_id, s.parent_id, s.duration FROM ts_win AS s INNER JOIN slow_traces AS t USING (trace_id) ORDER BY s.trace_id, s.duration DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'IG01')) AS IG01, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'IG02')) AS IG02, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'MG01')) AS MG01, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'MG02')) AS MG02, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat01')) AS T01, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat02')) AS T02, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat03')) AS T03, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat04')) AS T04, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (cmdb_id ~~ 'docker%')) AS dockers FROM ts_win WHERE (duration > 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH slow_ig AS (SELECT trace_id, span_id, ts AS p_ts, cmdb_id AS p_host, duration AS p_dur FROM ts_win WHERE ((duration > 5000) AND (cmdb_id IN ('IG01', 'IG02')) AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:45:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:05:00' AS TIMESTAMP))))SELECT p.p_host, c.cmdb_id AS child_host, count_star() AS n_edges, round(avg(date_diff('millisecond', p.p_ts, c.ts)), 0) AS avg_gap_ms, round(max(date_diff('millisecond', p.p_ts, c.ts)), 0) AS max_gap_ms, round(avg(c.duration), 1) AS avg_child_dur FROM slow_ig AS p INNER JOIN ts_win AS c ON (((c.parent_id = p.span_id) AND (c.cmdb_id NOT IN ('IG01', 'IG02')))) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

WITH ig AS (SELECT trace_id, span_id, ts AS p_ts, cmdb_id AS p_host, duration AS p_dur FROM ts_win WHERE (cmdb_id IN ('IG01', 'IG02')))SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), p.p_ts) AS b, c.cmdb_id AS child_host, count_star() AS n, round(avg(date_diff('millisecond', p.p_ts, c.ts)), 1) AS avg_gap_ms, round(quantile_cont(date_diff('millisecond', p.p_ts, c.ts), 0.99), 0) AS p99_gap_ms FROM ig AS p INNER JOIN ts_win AS c ON (((c.parent_id = p.span_id) AND (c.cmdb_id NOT IN ('IG01', 'IG02')))) WHERE (p.p_ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:30:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:15:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

SELECT p.cmdb_id AS parent_host, c.cmdb_id AS child_host, count_star() AS n, round(avg(date_diff('millisecond', p.ts, c.ts)), 0) AS avg_gap, round(max(date_diff('millisecond', p.ts, c.ts)), 0) AS max_gap FROM ts_win AS p INNER JOIN ts_win AS c ON ((c.parent_id = p.span_id)) WHERE ((p.ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:10:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AND (date_diff('millisecond', p.ts, c.ts) > 1000) AND (p.cmdb_id != c.cmdb_id)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10000

WITH slow_ig AS (SELECT trace_id, span_id, ts AS p_ts, cmdb_id AS p_host, duration AS p_dur FROM ts_win WHERE ((duration > 5000) AND (cmdb_id IN ('IG01', 'IG02')) AND (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:45:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:05:00' AS TIMESTAMP)))), edge AS (SELECT p.p_host, p.p_dur, date_diff('millisecond', p.p_ts, c.ts) AS gap_ms, c.duration AS child_dur, ((p.p_dur - date_diff('millisecond', p.p_ts, c.ts)) - c.duration) AS tail_ms FROM slow_ig AS p INNER JOIN ts_win AS c ON (((c.parent_id = p.span_id) AND (c.cmdb_id NOT IN ('IG01', 'IG02')))))SELECT p_host, count_star() AS n, round(avg(p_dur), 0) AS avg_total, round(avg(gap_ms), 0) AS avg_gap, round(avg(child_dur), 1) AS avg_child, round(avg(tail_ms), 0) AS avg_tail FROM edge GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT time_bucket(CAST('5 minutes' AS INTERVAL), ts) AS b, cmdb_id, count_star() AS n FROM ts_win WHERE (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:40:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:10:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW ig_t04 AS
SELECT p.cmdb_id AS ig, p.ts AS p_ts, p.duration AS p_dur,
       date_diff('millisecond', p.ts, c.ts) AS gap_ms, c.duration AS child_dur
FROM ts_win p JOIN ts_win c ON c.parent_id = p.span_id
WHERE p.cmdb_id IN ('IG01','IG02') AND c.cmdb_id = 'Tomcat04';

SELECT date_trunc('minute', p_ts) AS m, count_star() AS n, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (gap_ms > 500)) AS n_slow, round(((100.0 * count_star() FILTER (WHERE (gap_ms > 500))) / count_star()), 1) AS pct_slow, round(min(gap_ms), 0) AS min_gap, round(median(gap_ms), 0) AS med_gap, round(avg(gap_ms), 0) AS avg_gap, round(max(gap_ms), 0) AS max_gap FROM ig_t04 WHERE (p_ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:44:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:06:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT CASE  WHEN ((gap_ms < 10)) THEN ('a: <10ms') WHEN ((gap_ms < 500)) THEN ('b: 10-500ms') WHEN ((gap_ms < 1500)) THEN ('c: 0.5-1.5s') WHEN ((gap_ms < 3000)) THEN ('d: 1.5-3s') WHEN ((gap_ms < 5000)) THEN ('e: 3-5s') ELSE 'f: >5s' END AS bucket, count_star() AS n, round(min(gap_ms), 0) AS mn, round(max(gap_ms), 0) AS mx FROM ig_t04 WHERE (p_ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:50:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT gap_ms, count_star() AS n FROM ig_t04 WHERE ((p_ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:50:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AND (gap_ms > 500)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT CASE  WHEN ((((p_dur - gap_ms) - child_dur) < 500)) THEN ('a: <0.5s') WHEN ((((p_dur - gap_ms) - child_dur) < 3000)) THEN ('b: 0.5-3s') WHEN ((((p_dur - gap_ms) - child_dur) < 6000)) THEN ('c: 3-6s') WHEN ((((p_dur - gap_ms) - child_dur) < 10000)) THEN ('d: 6-10s') ELSE 'e: >10s' END AS tail_bucket, count_star() AS n, round(min(((p_dur - gap_ms) - child_dur)), 0) AS mn, round(max(((p_dur - gap_ms) - child_dur)), 0) AS mx FROM ig_t04 WHERE (p_ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:50:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

SELECT date_trunc('minute', p.ts) AS m, c.cmdb_id, count_star() AS n, count_star() FILTER (WHERE (date_diff('millisecond', p.ts, c.ts) > 500)) AS n_slow, round(max(date_diff('millisecond', p.ts, c.ts)), 0) AS max_gap FROM ts_win AS p INNER JOIN ts_win AS c ON ((c.parent_id = p.span_id)) WHERE ((p.cmdb_id IN ('IG01', 'IG02')) AND (c.cmdb_id IN ('Tomcat01', 'Tomcat02', 'Tomcat03')) AND (p.ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:50:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 01:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP))) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 10000

SELECT main.date_part('minute', ts) AS minute_of_hour, count_star() AS n, count(DISTINCT cmdb_id) AS hosts, round(max("value"), 0) AS max_v FROM mc_day WHERE ((kpi_name ~~ '%sdb_DSKRead') AND ("value" > 100) AND (cmdb_id ~~ 'Tomcat%')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT main.date_part('minute', ts) AS minute_of_hour, count_star() AS n, count(DISTINCT cmdb_id) AS hosts, round(max("value"), 0) AS max_v FROM mc_day WHERE ((kpi_name ~~ '%sda_DSKRead') AND ("value" > 100) AND (cmdb_id != 'apache01')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10000

SELECT ts, list(cmdb_id ORDER BY "value" DESC) AS hosts, round(max("value"), 0) AS max_v, count_star() AS n_hosts FROM mc_day WHERE ((kpi_name ~~ '%sd__DSKRead') AND ("value" > 500) AND (cmdb_id != 'apache01')) GROUP BY 1 HAVING (count_star() >= 2) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10000

WITH t AS (SELECT kpi_name, "value", (ts BETWEEN CAST('2021-03-06 00:52:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND CAST('2021-03-06 00:58:00' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS in_win FROM mc WHERE (cmdb_id = 'Tomcat04')), s AS (SELECT kpi_name, avg("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)) AS b_avg, stddev_samp("value") FILTER (WHERE (NOT in_win)) AS b_sd, max("value") FILTER (WHERE in_win) AS w_max, count_star() FILTER (WHERE in_win) AS w_n FROM t GROUP BY 1)SELECT kpi_name, round(b_avg, 3) AS b_avg, round(w_max, 3) AS w_max, round(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0)), 2) AS z FROM s WHERE ((w_n >= 2) AND (abs(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0))) > 4)) ORDER BY abs(((w_max - b_avg) / "nullif"(b_sd, 0))) DESC LIMIT 10000
